title: Oxopyrrolidine-Acylhydrazone Scaffolds as Dual Inducers of Autophagy and Ferroptosis in the Breast Cancer via JNK/Beclin-1/GPX4 Regulation.
snippet: Autophagy and ferroptosis are evolutionarily conserved stress-response pathways that critically regulate tumor progression and therapeutic responsiveness. title: Beyond the Microbial Hypothesis: Shared Genetic, Osteoimmune and Vascular Mechanisms in the Oral-Brain Axis Linking Periodontitis and Alzheimer's Disease.
snippet: Periodontitis, a chronic inflammatory disease of the tooth-supporting tissues, is increasingly linked to Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet mechanistic accounts of this 'oral-brain axis' have been dominated by microbial translocation and the gingipain hypothesis.
